page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.4xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance optimized for balanced compute and memory resource distribution. Built on an x86_64 architecture with a KVM hypervisor, it features 16 vCPUs across 8 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores operating at 2.7 GHz with hyper-threading. The memory configuration provides 64 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware cache specifications include 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and 48 MB of L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512 VNNI, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. The instance provides 10 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, contains no integrated local NVMe or SSD storage, and includes zero GPU accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations position the server within the average performance tier across compute, memory, and application tests. The CPU scores 20920.78 on PassMark and achieves a multi-core score of 9721.0 on Geekbench, alongside 15531.53 on multi-core stress-ng tests. Memory bandwidth reaches 97.84 GB/sec for uncached large block reads and 846.65 GB/sec for cached small block reads. In application-level tests, the server processes 15.69 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves 20.98 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. CPU-based small LLM inference for a 135M model reaches 258.46 text generation tokens per second, while a 7B model processes 11.58 text generation tokens per second.

The absence of local block storage requires reliance on attached network storage volumes, focusing instance utilization entirely on host processing and memory throughput. The balanced hardware design offers cost-effective execution for non-storage-bound workloads that do not demand GPU acceleration. The instance is suited for general web application serving, backend microservices, container control planes, application middleware, and distributed in-memory caching systems.
